metadata.notes: DeepSeek Harness supports a synchronous foreground child, but the DSH adapter rejects the child's bare UUID transcript directory and does not read the durable parentSession header.

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: bug
driver_capability: ready

## Agent capability

DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 ships a first-class `subagent` tool. The installed official package reference states that one-shot foreground calls wait for the child and return the child's final text. The shipped standard preset configures `subagent` with the in-process spawn provider and continuable background mode, while the tool schema makes `run_in_background: false` the explicit foreground override. The recipe uses that exact override, so the parent cannot finish its next action until the child result arrives.

The in-process driver creates a separate child Agent and Session. `childSessionMeta` writes the parent's durable session id to `parentSession` and writes `origin: subagent` in the child session header. The persistence backend writes each session to its own directory under the same `$DSH_HOME/sessions` root. The child id is a bare `randomUUID()`, not the top-level TUI's `session-<uuid>` form. The TUI source also documents that the bare child id is the on-disk persisted directory name. Thus the agent emits both required facts: a durable child transcript and a durable child-to-parent link.

## Daemon capability

The current DSH adapter mishandles those shipped traces in two concrete ways. First, `sessionIDFromPath` accepts only directory names matching `^session-<uuid>$`. It returns an empty id for the bare UUID directory that the official child driver creates, so `FilesUnderRoot` skips the child transcript and no child `SessionState` or `transcript_new` event appears. Second, `Source()` does not set `ParentSessionIDFromPath`, although the first physical header contains `parentSession`. The parser handles the `session` header only for version and cwd and discards the parent field. Even if the child id filter were widened, the child would remain top-level, `parent_linked` would not fire, and `SubagentCount(parent)` would remain zero.

This is `daemon=bug`, not `incapable`. The durable child transcript and its exact parent id exist under the root the adapter already tails. Irrlicht has the `ParentSessionIDFromPath` source seam for this header-based layout, but this adapter does not use it and rejects the child's valid id. The correct expected spec remains known-failing until both adapter defects are fixed. The parent's own working-to-ready arc can still appear because the foreground tool call stays open until the child returns; that parent-only arc does not prove child observability.

## Driver capability and recipe

The interactive driver implements `send`, `wait_turn`, and `sleep`, which are the only required steps. The prompt requires exactly one `subagent` call, explicitly sets `run_in_background` to false, gives the child a deterministic exact-token task, and pins the parent's final text. The 420-second budget covers the parent tool-selection request, the child request, and the parent's final continuation on the local model. The trailing 10-second sleep matches the longest committed sibling settle delay and gives the daemon time to observe the final compressed frames.

The spec asserts the correct parent and child topology. A raw parent-transcript assertion requires one `subagent` call whose arguments contain `run_in_background:false`, plus the matching successful result containing `CHILD_OK`. Therefore an ordinary parent turn or an accidentally backgrounded child cannot satisfy the non-vacuous part of the fixture. The model and token assertions use the driver's exact live route. Cost may remain zero because the route is local LM Studio.
caveats: Known daemon bug: core/adapters/inbound/agents/dsh/adapter.go accepts only session-<uuid> directory names, but @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-in-process-driver creates a bare UUID child id; the fswatcher therefore skips the durable child transcript.

Known daemon bug: the DSH child session header carries parentSession, but core/adapters/inbound/agents/dsh/agent.go declares no ParentSessionIDFromPath extractor and parser.go discards that header field. No parent_linked event or SubagentCount can be produced until the adapter reads it.

Emission is source-confirmed but not live-recorded in this cell. A recording must confirm that this installed TUI profile persists the foreground child before record promotes the child-transcript claim from provisional to settled.

Vacuous-pass condition: the parent lifecycle alone could pass after an ordinary turn or an accidentally backgrounded child. The transcript assertion therefore requires exactly one subagent tool call with run_in_background:false and its matching successful CHILD_OK result.

Load-bearing environment precondition: the active standard preset must expose the in-process subagent tool, and LM Studio must still expose qwen/qwen3.5-9b. Record must re-probe both instead of trusting this assessment.
The child runs in the same dsh process and uses a bare UUID. Do not require a distinct child PID; require a distinct child SessionState and ParentSessionID link.

sources.note: Official installed package reference: foreground calls wait for the child and return its final text; run_in_background:false selects foreground under continuable mode.
Shipped standard preset mounts tool-subagent with provider spawn, toolName subagent, and backgroundMode continuable.
Official installed implementation creates a separate child with a bare randomUUID and passes childSessionMeta into the child Agent creation transaction.
childSessionMeta writes parentSession: parentHeader.id and origin: subagent into the durable child header.
Official persistence contract: every session gets its own session-owned directory and physical header under the configured sessions root.
Installed TUI source states that a subagent child id is a bare id and that its on-disk persisted directory uses that same bare id.
sessionIDPattern requires session-<uuid>; sessionIDFromPath returns empty for the official bare UUID child directory.
FilesUnderRoot declares SessionIDFromPath but no ParentSessionIDFromPath extractor.
parseSession validates version and reads cwd, then skips the header without reading parentSession.
ParentSessionIDFromPath is the existing daemon seam for flat transcript stores whose parent relationship lives in a metadata header.
Driver implements send, wait_turn, and sleep and pins the local LM Studio model through per-run settings.

preconditions: dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 or newer is on PATH and the active TUI profile uses the standard preset
the active preset exposes the in-process subagent tool and accepts run_in_background:false; re-probe the live tool surface at record time
LM Studio is serving qwen/qwen3.5-9b through http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1; re-probe the live model roster at record time
irrlichd is recording with DeepSeek Harness transcript permission granted
setup: Create a fresh per-run cwd and launch the DSH TUI through the interactive driver
Apply the temporary LM Studio and qwen model patch without modifying the installed TUI profile
Resolve the post-marker parent session.v3.jsonl.zstd before sending input

script.text: Use the subagent tool exactly once. Set description to read marker. Set prompt to: Reply with exactly CHILD_OK and no other text. Set run_in_background to false so you wait for the child result. After the child result arrives, reply with exactly DONE and no other text.

verify: the raw parent transcript contains exactly one subagent tool call whose arguments explicitly set run_in_background to false
the subagent call has a matching successful tool result containing CHILD_OK, so a background acknowledgement cannot pass
events.jsonl shows a distinct child transcript_new event after the parent enters working
events.jsonl shows parent_linked for that child with ParentSessionID equal to the parent session id
the parent remains working across the foreground child lifetime and returns to ready only after the child result arrives
the recording reports model qwen/qwen3.5-9b and non-zero tokens
recipe.scope_note: The 10-second trailing delay matches the longest committed foreground-subagent sibling settle delay. The 420-second budget covers three local-model decisions: parent delegation, child answer, and parent final reply.
